001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.database.bean;
002
003import java.util.Objects;
004
005public class ShopRecord {
006
007  private DataRecord dataRecord;
008  private InfoRecord infoRecord;
009
010  // Extra fields
011  private int cachedStock;
012  private int cachedSpace;
013
014  public ShopRecord(final DataRecord dataRecord, final InfoRecord infoRecord, final int cachedStock, final int cachedSpace) {
015
016    this.dataRecord = dataRecord;
017    this.infoRecord = infoRecord;
018    this.cachedStock = cachedStock;
019    this.cachedSpace = cachedSpace;
020  }
021
022  public DataRecord getDataRecord() {
023
024    return this.dataRecord;
025  }
026
027  public InfoRecord getInfoRecord() {
028
029    return this.infoRecord;
030  }
031
032  public int getCachedStock() {
033
034    return this.cachedStock;
035  }
036
037  public int getCachedSpace() {
038
039    return this.cachedSpace;
040  }
041
042  public void setDataRecord(final DataRecord dataRecord) {
043
044    this.dataRecord = dataRecord;
045  }
046
047  public void setInfoRecord(final InfoRecord infoRecord) {
048
049    this.infoRecord = infoRecord;
050  }
051
052  public void setCachedStock(final int cachedStock) {
053
054    this.cachedStock = cachedStock;
055  }
056
057  public void setCachedSpace(final int cachedSpace) {
058
059    this.cachedSpace = cachedSpace;
060  }
061
062  @Override
063  public boolean equals(final Object o) {
064
065    if(o == this) return true;
066    if(!(o instanceof ShopRecord)) return false;
067    final ShopRecord other = (ShopRecord)o;
068    return this.getCachedStock() == other.getCachedStock()
069           && this.getCachedSpace() == other.getCachedSpace()
070           && Objects.equals(this.getDataRecord(), other.getDataRecord())
071           && Objects.equals(this.getInfoRecord(), other.getInfoRecord());
072  }
073
074  @Override
075  public int hashCode() {
076
077    return Objects.hash(this.getCachedStock(), this.getCachedSpace(), this.getDataRecord(), this.getInfoRecord());
078  }
079
080  @Override
081  public String toString() {
082
083    return "ShopRecord(dataRecord=" + this.getDataRecord() + ", infoRecord=" + this.getInfoRecord() + ", cachedStock=" + this.getCachedStock() + ", cachedSpace=" + this.getCachedSpace() + ")";
084  }
085}
